name: Life Goes On
source:
Takashi is a boy who saw his parents killed right before his eyes. He lost his memories and can't remember the face of the murderer. He only had one clue: Cross Academy. Ten years later he transferred here. Join him on this quest because he might find who killed his parents, regain his memories and he might find true love.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/lifevamp.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
隆曾亲眼目睹父母遇害。那场惨剧令他失去记忆，再也想不起凶手的面孔。他唯一掌握的线索，是“十字学园”。十年后，隆转入这所学校。陪伴他踏上追寻真相的道路吧：他或许能找到杀害父母的凶手、恢复失去的记忆，也可能邂逅真正的爱情。

[内容取自[url=http://renai.us/game/lifevamp.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
